newsitem.title: USA: Israel's Koor, Nice near highs.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Koor, Nice near highs.

text.p: Israeli companies Nice Systems Ltd and Koor Industries Ltd rose to near 12-month highs Tuesday in heavy volume.

Nice Systems, a maker of digital recording and retrieval systems, was up 1/2 to 38-1/4, a year high. Koor, Israeli's biggest conglomerate, rose 5/8 to 22-3/8 in volume that was almost three times daily levels.
Koor had reached 22-13/16, above its record closing level of 22-1/2, before easing.
Traders and analysts said Nice Systems, had been helped by recent presentations to analysts and by a secondary share offering.
"It's just acting great after the secondary," a trader said. "There is nothing but buyers around."
The rise in Koor, Israeli's biggest business conglomerate, followed large block trades in its shares on the Tel Aviv exchange.
